ostrzezenia.tekst: Untested recipes can be prepared and stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks; do not store them on the counter.
Use only vinegar labelled 5% acidity; white and cider vinegar can be used interchangeably; do not use wine vinegars, homemade vinegar or lemon juice.
Refrigerator pickles are not heat processed, so they must be kept in the refrigerator; do not decrease the vinegar in them, because an unsafe product may result.

akapity: The NC State Extension and UC Master Food Preserver method for quick refrigerator pickles lists onions, cucumbers, asparagus, parsnips, radishes and pea pods as good vegetables to start with; it does not list cabbage.
Cabbage is a vegetable, and all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
